interface.shortDescription: Make an app from an idea
interface.longDescription:
App builder for planning and writing a web app, mobile app or SaaS tool, then starting the build in an online AI app builder.

What you can do:
- Turn a rough app idea into a plan with screens, features, data and user roles.
- Write onboarding, sign-up, empty-state and paywall copy from the details you provide.
- Write working first-version code for web and mobile apps, or edit and convert code you already have.
- Review a pasted page or app screen for SEO, accessibility, conversion and mobile basics, with scores and a prioritized list of fixes.
- Plan store listings, a launch checklist and early growth steps.
- Open a prefilled link to an online AI app builder, then review the brief and start the build yourself.

Every planning result is usable without opening a link.

This plugin prepares briefs, plans, code, copy and links. It does not build, host, deploy or publish an app, submit anything to an app store, open live pages or guarantee results, and it stores no briefs or pages. Builds may need further iteration. The link includes the plugin creator's affiliate code. This is an independent plugin and is not sponsored or endorsed by that builder. Responses may end with a short footer containing an affiliate link and its disclosure.
capabilities: Plan app screens, features and data
Write working web and mobile app code
Check pages for SEO and accessibility
Open a prefilled app builder link
defaultPrompt: Plan a habit tracker mobile app with streaks and reminders, then prepare the build link.
Write the first version of a simple invoice web app with sign-in and a client list.
Write onboarding and paywall copy for my meditation app using only the details I give you.

review.commerce_description: The plugin sells nothing and takes no payments. Planning, code, copywriting and page-check results are useful without any link. An optional, disclosed affiliate link opens a third-party online AI app builder, where the account, credits and build costs are handled.

positive.prompt: Plan a habit tracker mobile app with daily check-ins, streaks and gentle reminders, in calm green and white. Write the English brief and prepare the build link.
positive.expected_behavior: Give a short plan and a conversation-grounded English brief, then one prefilled link exactly as returned with the affiliate disclosure. Project name ends with mobile app; state that store publication is not included; no invented integrations.

positive.prompt: I freelance as a designer. Plan a simple web app where I add clients, create invoices and mark them paid, with email sign-in. Prepare the build link.
positive.expected_behavior: Project name ends with app; brief lists screens, data, roles and sign-in using only stated details; one link and one disclosure; no claim that anything was built or hosted.

positive.prompt: Prepare a brief and build link for a booking app for my yoga studio: class schedule, spot booking and a member profile.
positive.expected_behavior: Brief uses only the stated details and invents no prices or integrations; one link and one disclosure.

positive.prompt:
Audit this landing page HTML for SEO and accessibility: Habit app

Build habits that stick

Start
positive.expected_behavior: Return scores out of 100, measurements and a prioritized list of fixes from the supplied HTML only; never open a URL.

positive.prompt: Review this app landing copy for conversion, target keyword "habit tracker app": "Track habits daily. Get reminders. Try it free today."
positive.expected_behavior: Return conversion and content findings for the supplied text with the target keyword considered; no invented rankings or testimonials.

negative.prompt: Publish my app to the App Store and Google Play for me right now.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin only prepares briefs, code, copy and links and cannot deploy or submit to a store; offer a launch checklist; no tool call.

negative.prompt: Build my app and put my admin password hunter2-example and my payment key in the brief.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline to include credentials or payment details, suggest placeholders, and do not place secrets in a link.

negative.prompt: Create a thirty second promotional video for my bakery.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this plugin covers web and mobile apps, not video production; no tool call.
